title: Military Family USMC Birthday Ball
intro: All ranks are welcome to attend this family event!

sections.heading: Military Family USMC Birthday Ball
sections.markdown:
**All ranks are welcome to attend this family event!**

November is the Month of the Military Family. The Military Family USMC Birthday Ball will be in celebration of military children and in recognition of the Marine Corps 251st Birthday. This event honors Marine Corps history and traditions. The Birthday Ball is also an opportunity to show appreciation for the sacrifices that many of the youngest family members endure while their military parent(s) serves.

There will be lots of family fun to include a traditional cake cutting ceremony, guest speaker, dancing, delicious kid-friendly buffet options, and other fun activities you won't want to miss!

Dress code for civilians is semi-formal.

Dress code for military is Dress Blue Bravos or branch equivalent.

Open to all DoD Authorized Patrons.

For more information, call 703.784.2687/9421 or email [SMB_MCCSQuanticoMCFTB@usmc.mil](mailto:SMB_MCCSQuanticoMCFTB@usmc.mil)

For Base access information visit: [https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/)

**Click here to purchase [Tickets on Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2001013168252?aff=oddtdtcreator)**
